findings.title: javascript.express.db.sequelize-express.sequelize-express
findings.description:
Rule ID: javascript.express.db.sequelize-express.sequelize-express
File: C:\Tools\DevSecOps\juice-shop\data\static\codefixes\dbSchemaChallenge_1.ts
Line: 5

Classification: True Positive
Confidence: 100
Risk: HIGH

Reasoning:
User-controlled input 'criteria' is directly used in a SQL query string, which can lead to SQL injection.

Evidence:
Source: req.query.q
Intermediate Flow: criteria = (req.query.q.length <= 200) ? req.query.q : req.query.q.substring(0, 200)
Sink: models.sequelize.query("SELECT * FROM Products WHERE ((name LIKE '%"+criteria+"%" OR description LIKE '%"+criteria+"%") AND deletedAt IS NULL) ORDER BY name")
findings.mitigation: Use parameterized queries or ORM methods to avoid SQL injection.
findings.impact: User-controlled input 'criteria' is directly used in a SQL query string, which can lead to SQL injection.
